title: A moment of relief
prompt:
Create artwork for a narrative incremental bunker-defense game. Weathered industrial electrical science fiction; painterly, grounded game illustration with crisp readable silhouettes. Charcoal steel, dirty concrete, aged copper, pale cyan electricity, warm amber shelter lights. Restrained detail at small display sizes. Shared engineering signature: asymmetrical copper winding, three ceramic insulators, hand-cut fastening plate with a clipped upper-right corner. No logos, watermarks, captions, or readable text; evidence text and UI labels will be added separately.

Working character design: a lean man in his late fifties, long angular face, tired gray eyes, swept-back graying dark hair, short uneven stubble, weathered charcoal work coat, patched brown waistcoat, insulated left glove, round goggles at the collar, old branching electrical burn on the right wrist. Human and frightened when threatened, without a theatrical villain grin. This design is provisional until its reference sheet is approved.

Attach approved style, subject, and location reference images when available. Preserve their identity, proportions, materials, and engineering details exactly. If no reference is attached, use the written working design consistently. Generate one image for this request.

REQUEST: The scientist sits exhausted against the bunker wall after the attack. Warm low light reveals prepared equipment and supplies. Quiet, intimate composition without explanatory text.

COMPOSITION AND OUTPUT: Landscape 16:9, opaque background.

REFERENCE INPUTS: Scientist reference; bunker reference; enemy references.

PRODUCTION PASS: Use case: illustration-story. Attached images are provisional production references from this batch, not claims of human approval. Image 1: scientist-reference, reference for its subject and materials. Image 2: bunker-reference, reference for its subject and materials. Image 3: defense-coil-idle, reference for its subject and materials. Image 4: scrap-walker-idle, reference for its subject and materials. Keep the machinery in shadow when the scientist is the subject. Maintain consistent identity and architecture. Wide story panel, one scene, no grid. Generate the one requested image, no reference-sheet collage unless this request explicitly asks for a kit or reference sheet.
review: Door remains open with a distant threat visible. Close or secure it for continuity with the previous shelter beat.
